list.name: deep flooding in 2050
list.why: more than 1.5 m of water in a 2050 surge; give it back to the sea

list.name: water's edge
list.why: a continuous public edge and room for wetland

list.name: outside the design area
list.why: existing city outside the design area is context; industrial land stays designable

list.name: shallow flooding in 2050
list.why: floods up to 1.5 m in a 2050 surge

list.name: rain hollows
list.why: rainwater collects here; keep it as storage

list.name: valleys
list.why: water runs here; keep the channel open for drainage, storage and wetland

list.name: valley buffer (provisional)
list.why: room either side of the channel, wider for bigger streams

list.name: breeze edge
list.why: keep low near the water so the breeze reaches inland

list.name: industrial land
list.why: likely contaminated; clean-up comes before building
